_doc: Per letter id (order P, I…VIII, E): words = 5–8 lemma keys of lexicon_en.json chosen from the English line (same rules as daily.json); spots = []; phrases = 2 expressions from the English line.

phrases.note_ko: better than + 사람: ‘~보다 더 잘’. anyone 은 ‘누구든’.
phrases.note_en: better than anyone = more than any other person could.

phrases.note_ko: send + 사람 + 물건: ‘~에게 ~을 보내다’.
phrases.note_en: send + person + thing: the person comes first.

phrases.note_ko: news 는 늘 단수 취급해요 (The news is …).
phrases.note_en: news is always singular: ‘the news is good’.

phrases.note_ko: in the afternoon · in the morning · at night 처럼 전치사가 달라요.
phrases.note_en: in the afternoon / in the morning, but at night.

phrases.note_ko: let me know: ‘나에게 알려 줘’ 하는 자주 쓰는 말.
phrases.note_en: let me know = tell me (very common).

phrases.note_ko: in + 기간: 지금부터 ‘~ 뒤에’.
phrases.note_en: in + a period = after that time from now.

phrases.t: I wake up full of you
phrases.en: you are my first thought when I wake
phrases.note_ko: wake up: ‘잠에서 깨다’. full of + 명사: ‘~로 가득한’.
phrases.note_en: wake up = stop sleeping; full of = containing a lot of.

phrases.t: I'll see you in three hours
phrases.en: we'll meet three hours from now
phrases.note_ko: I'll see you …: 헤어질 때 ‘~에 봐’ 하는 흔한 말.
phrases.note_en: I'll see you (in/at …) is a common way to arrange the next meeting.

phrases.note_ko: far from + 사람 · 곳: ‘~에서 멀리’.
phrases.note_en: far from + person/place = a long way from.

phrases.en: what my whole life is about
phrases.note_ko: 요즘 영어에서는 ‘늘 이렇지 뭐’ 하는 자조로도 써요. 여기서는 말 그대로예요.
phrases.note_en: Today people often say it wryly (‘typical!’); here it is meant literally.

phrases.note_ko: every + 단수 명사 (every day, every night).
phrases.note_en: every takes a singular noun.

phrases.note_ko: by + 사람의 side: ‘~ 곁에’. 늘 함께 있다는 느낌.
phrases.note_en: by someone's side = right next to them, keeping them company.

phrases.note_ko: as + 형용사 + as: ‘~만큼 …한’.
phrases.note_en: as + adjective + as compares two equal things.

phrases.en: she has given birth to a daughter
phrases.note_ko: have a baby / a girl / a boy: ‘아기를 / 딸을 / 아들을 낳다’.
phrases.note_en: have a girl / a boy = give birth to one.

phrases.note_ko: 현재진행형 의문문: 지금 하고 있는 일을 물어요.
phrases.note_en: Present continuous question: asking about what is happening now.

phrases.en: too many things at the same time
phrases.note_ko: at once: ‘한꺼번에’ (또는 ‘당장’).
phrases.note_en: at once = at the same time (or: immediately).

phrases.note_ko: write + 사람 + 무엇: ‘~에게 …을 써 주다’.
phrases.note_en: write + person + thing: write me a letter.

phrases.note_ko: without + 사람: ‘~ 없이는’.
phrases.note_en: without you = if you are not there.

phrases.note_ko: full of + 명사: ‘~로 가득한’.
phrases.note_en: full of + noun = containing a lot of.

phrases.en: does she really have so much to do?
phrases.note_ko: so + 형용사: ‘그렇게 ~한’ (놀람 · 서운함).
phrases.note_en: so + adjective adds surprise or reproach.

phrases.note_ko: fill A with B: ‘A를 B로 채우다’.
phrases.note_en: fill A with B = make A full of B.

phrases.note_ko: 숫자 + times more: ‘~배 더’.
phrases.note_en: number + times more = multiplied by that number.

phrases.note_ko: often(자주) 앞에 very 를 붙여 강조해요.
phrases.note_en: very makes often stronger.

phrases.note_ko: here I am: 도착했거나 나타났을 때 하는 말.
phrases.note_en: Said when you arrive or suddenly appear.

phrases.note_ko: stay in bed: 아파서 일어나지 않고 누워 있다.
phrases.note_en: To remain in bed, usually because you are ill.

phrases.note_ko: a little + 비교급: ‘조금 더 ~한’.
phrases.note_en: a little + comparative = slightly more …

phrases.note_ko: 앞말과 정반대를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.note_en: Used to say the opposite of what was just said.

phrases.note_ko: before long = 오래지 않아, 곧.
phrases.note_en: before long = soon, quite soon.

phrases.note_ko: weren't = were not. there 는 앞에서 말한 그곳.
phrases.note_en: weren't = were not; there points back to the place just named.

phrases.note_ko: be made for: ‘~을 위해 있다, ~에 딱 맞다’.
phrases.note_en: be made for = be just right for.

phrases.note_ko: be wrong: 틀리다, 잘못 생각하다.
phrases.note_en: be wrong = to be mistaken.

phrases.note_ko: make + 사람 + 형용사: ‘~를 …하게 하다’.
phrases.note_en: make + person + adjective = cause someone to be …

phrases.note_ko: go for a walk = 산책하다. go for a swim · a drive 도 같은 꼴.
phrases.note_en: Also go for a swim, go for a drive.

phrases.en: it will be good for you
phrases.note_ko: do someone good: ~에게 좋다, 기운 나게 하다.
phrases.note_en: do someone good = be good for someone's health or mood.

phrases.note_ko: beg: 간절히 빌다. 아주 강한 부탁.
phrases.note_en: beg = ask very strongly.

phrases.note_ko: 편지 끝인사로 써요. ‘다 네 거야’ 하고 물건을 건넬 때도.
phrases.note_en: A letter closing; also said when handing something over (‘it's all yours’).

phrases.note_ko: since + 시작점: 그때부터 지금까지. 동사는 현재완료 (I've been).
phrases.note_en: since + a starting point; the verb is present perfect (I've been).

phrases.note_ko: on one's way: 가는 · 오는 길에.
phrases.note_en: on one's way = travelling, coming.

phrases.note_ko: can't stand + 명사 · -ing: 아주 싫어서 못 참다.
phrases.note_en: can't stand = cannot bear, really dislike.

phrases.note_ko: be back: 돌아와 있다. I'll = I will.
phrases.note_en: be back = return; I'll = I will.

phrases.note_ko: so + 형용사 + that …: ‘너무 ~해서 …’.
phrases.note_en: so + adjective + that … = to such a degree that …

phrases.note_ko: still: 아직도. hurt: 아프다.
phrases.note_en: still = even now; hurt = be painful.

phrases.note_ko: go + -ing: 놀이 · 활동하러 가다 (go shopping, go fishing).
phrases.note_en: go + -ing for activities: go shopping, go fishing.

phrases.note_ko: better 는 good · well 의 비교급. 아팠다가 나아질 때.
phrases.note_en: better = comparative of well; said when someone recovers.

phrases.note_ko: in + 기간: ‘(지금부터) ~ 뒤에’.
phrases.note_en: in + length of time = after that much time from now.

phrases.note_ko: without + 사람 · 명사: ~ 없이.
phrases.note_en: without + person/noun.

phrases.note_ko: on the move: 한곳에 머물지 않고 계속 움직이는.
phrases.note_en: on the move = moving from place to place.

phrases.note_ko: manage to + 동사원형: 어렵게 해내다.
phrases.note_en: manage to + verb = succeed in doing something difficult.

phrases.note_ko: since + 시각: 그때부터 지금까지. 동사는 현재완료.
phrases.note_en: since + a point in time; the verb is present perfect.

phrases.en: I really want to see you
phrases.note_ko: long to + 동사원형: 간절히 ~하고 싶다 (조금 문어적).
phrases.note_en: long to + verb = to want very much (a little literary).

phrases.note_ko: nothing + 형용사: 형용사가 뒤에 와요 (nothing new, something interesting).
phrases.note_en: nothing / something + adjective: the adjective comes after (nothing new, something interesting).

phrases.note_ko: 작별 인사로 자주 써요. 줄여서 Take care!
phrases.note_en: A common way to say goodbye; short form: Take care!

phrases.en: it made me sad to see
phrases.note_ko: be sorry to + 동사: ‘~해서 유감이다, 마음이 아프다’.
phrases.note_en: be sorry to + verb = to feel sad or regret about something.

phrases.t: before the end of the month
phrases.en: by the end of this month
phrases.note_ko: before the end of + 기간: ‘~이 끝나기 전에’.
phrases.note_en: before the end of + a period = before it is over.

phrases.note_ko: by day ↔ by night: ‘낮에 · 밤에’ (조금 글말).
phrases.note_en: by day / by night = in the daytime / at night (a little literary).

phrases.note_ko: as soon as + 현재형: 미래의 일이어도 현재형을 써요.
phrases.note_en: as soon as + present tense, even about the future.

phrases.note_ko: from there to …: 여정을 차례로 말할 때.
phrases.note_en: from there to … lists the stages of a trip.

phrases.note_ko: a lot: 동사 뒤에서 ‘많이’. 날씨 주어는 it.
phrases.note_en: a lot after a verb = much; weather takes it as subject.

phrases.note_ko: not one + 명사: ‘단 하나도 없다’ (강조).
phrases.note_en: not one + noun = not a single … (emphatic).

phrases.note_ko: a few + 복수 명사: ‘몇몇의’. few (a 없이) 는 ‘거의 없는’.
phrases.note_en: a few + plural = some; few without a = hardly any.

phrases.note_ko: sorry to hear (that) …: 안 좋은 소식에 하는 말.
phrases.note_en: sorry to hear (that) … is what you say to bad news.

phrases.note_ko: make up one's mind: ‘결정하다’.
phrases.note_en: make up one's mind = to decide.

phrases.note_ko: at + 시각. o'clock 은 정각에만 (six o'clock).
phrases.note_en: at + clock time; o'clock only for the exact hour.

phrases.t: one from me, the other from the Empress
phrases.en: one is mine, the other the Empress's
phrases.note_ko: one … the other …: 둘 가운데 하나씩.
phrases.note_en: one … the other … = each of two.

phrases.t: it's not my fault but yours
phrases.note_ko: not A but B: ‘A가 아니라 B’.
phrases.note_en: not A but B = B, rather than A.

phrases.note_ko: be used to + 명사 · -ing: ‘~에 익숙하다’ (used to + 동사원형 ‘예전에 ~했다’와 달라요).
phrases.note_en: be used to + noun / -ing = be accustomed to (not the same as used to + verb).

phrases.note_ko: not … yet: ‘아직 ~않다’. 현재완료와 잘 어울려요.
phrases.note_en: not … yet = so far, not; it goes well with the present perfect.

phrases.note_ko: to tell the truth: 속마음을 털어놓을 때 앞에 붙여요.
phrases.note_en: to tell the truth = honestly (to introduce a frank remark).

phrases.note_ko: spend + 시간: ‘(시간을) 보내다’. spend the night, spend a week.
phrases.note_en: spend + time = to pass time somewhere: spend the night, spend a week.

phrases.note_ko: spirit: 기운, 용기 (여기서는 ‘의연함’).
phrases.note_en: spirit here = courage, strength of character.

phrases.t: it's been two or three days since
phrases.en: two or three days have passed since
phrases.note_ko: it's been + 기간 + since + 과거: ‘~한 지 ~됐다’.
phrases.note_en: it's been + time + since + past = time has passed since …

phrases.en: the snow is turning to water
phrases.note_ko: 현재진행형으로 지금 바뀌는 날씨를 말해요.
phrases.note_en: The present continuous describes weather that is changing now.

phrases.t: I wish I were near you
phrases.en: I'd like to be with you
phrases.note_ko: I wish + 과거형 (be 는 were): 지금 이룰 수 없는 바람.
phrases.note_en: I wish + past (be → were) = a wish that isn't true now.

phrases.note_ko: add to + 명사: ‘~을 더 크게 하다’.
phrases.note_en: add to + noun = to increase it.

phrases.note_ko: must + 동사원형: ‘~해야 한다’ (강한 의무).
phrases.note_en: must + base verb = a strong obligation.

phrases.en: stop thinking about it for a while
phrases.note_ko: take one's mind off …: 걱정에서 잠시 벗어나다.
phrases.note_en: take one's mind off … = to stop worrying about … for a while.

phrases.t: By the time you read this letter
phrases.note_ko: by the time + 현재형: ‘~할 무렵이면’. 뒤 문장은 will.
phrases.note_en: by the time + present = when …; the main clause uses will.

phrases.note_ko: alone 이 명사 · 대명사 뒤에서 ‘~만’.
phrases.note_en: alone after a noun or pronoun = only.

phrases.note_ko: give birth to + 아기: 아기를 낳다.
phrases.note_en: give birth to = to have (a baby).

phrases.note_ko: spend the night (at …): 어디에서 하룻밤 자다.
phrases.note_en: spend the night = to sleep somewhere for one night.

phrases.note_ko: 같은 말을 되풀이하는 말버릇: ‘어쩔 수 없다’. 영어에도 ‘rules are rules’ 같은 말이 있어요.
phrases.note_en: Saying the same thing twice means ‘that's how it is’, as in ‘rules are rules’.

phrases.note_ko: 편지 끝인사. 요즘은 ‘(이거) 다 네 거야, 가져가’ 라는 뜻으로도 써요.
phrases.note_en: A letter sign-off; today it also means ‘it's all yours, take it’.

phrases.note_ko: help + 명사: ~에 도움이 되다. 부정이면 오히려 나쁘게 한다는 느낌.
phrases.note_en: help = to make better; in the negative it suggests making things worse.

phrases.note_ko: before long: 머지않아, 곧.
phrases.note_en: before long = soon.

phrases.note_ko: do someone good: ~에게 이롭다 (건강 · 기분).
phrases.note_en: do someone good = to be good for their health or mood.

phrases.note_ko: in good shape: 몸 · 물건 · 일이 좋은 상태.
phrases.note_en: in good shape = in good condition (body, things, affairs).

phrases.note_ko: see no objection to + -ing: ~해도 괜찮다 (격식).
phrases.note_en: see no objection to + -ing = to be fine with (formal).

phrases.note_ko: rather: 꽤, 좀. 영국 영어에서 자주 써요.
phrases.note_en: rather = quite, fairly (common in British English).

phrases.note_ko: be worth + 값: 값이 ~이다. only 가 붙으면 ‘겨우’.
phrases.note_en: be worth + price; with only = no more than.

phrases.note_ko: whatever + 주어 + like: 원하는 것은 무엇이든.
phrases.note_en: whatever you like = anything you want.

phrases.note_ko: in advance: 미리, 앞서.
phrases.note_en: in advance = beforehand.

phrases.note_ko: can't wait (for/to): 몹시 기다리다. 부정형인데 ‘기대된다’는 뜻이에요.
phrases.note_en: can't wait = to be very eager (negative form, positive meaning).

phrases.note_ko: take care of: 돌보다, 챙기다.
phrases.note_en: take care of = to look after.

phrases.note_ko: 잠들기 전 인사. Sleep tight 도 같은 뜻이에요.
phrases.note_en: A bedtime wish; ‘sleep tight’ means the same.

phrases.note_ko: keep + -ing: 계속 ~하다.
phrases.note_en: keep + -ing = to go on doing.

phrases.note_ko: find one's feet: 새 처지에 익숙해지다, 다시 자리를 잡다.
phrases.note_en: find one's feet = to become steady or confident in a new situation.

phrases.note_ko: tell + 사람 (+ that …): 누구에게 말하다. say 는 사람을 바로 못 받아요 (said me ✗).
phrases.note_en: tell + person; say cannot take the person directly (not ‘said me’).

phrases.note_ko: seem + 형용사 (+ to 사람): ~에게 ~해 보이다.
phrases.note_en: seem + adjective (+ to someone).

phrases.note_ko: as much as you like: 원하는 만큼. 문장에서는 as much planted as you like 처럼 갈라졌어요.
phrases.note_en: as much (…) as you like = to your heart's content; here split by ‘planted’.

phrases.en: in whatever way you think best
phrases.note_ko: see fit: 옳다고 여기다. however = 어떤 방법으로든.
phrases.note_en: see fit = to think right; however = in whatever way.

phrases.note_ko: would have been: 그랬다면 ~였을 것 (지난 일 가정).
phrases.note_en: would have been = (if it had happened) it would have been.

phrases.note_ko: it seems: ~인 것 같다. 문장 가운데에 끼워 넣기도 해요.
phrases.note_en: it seems = apparently; it can sit in the middle of a sentence.

phrases.note_ko: grow up: 자라서 어른이 되다.
phrases.note_en: grow up = to become an adult.

phrases.en: become what he is meant to be
phrases.note_ko: fulfil: 이루다, 다하다 (미국 영어 fulfill).
phrases.note_en: fulfil = to carry out, achieve (US: fulfill).

phrases.note_ko: put aside: 따로 모아 두다.
phrases.note_en: put aside = to save for later.

phrases.note_ko: all the same: 그렇지만, 그래도.
phrases.note_en: all the same = nevertheless.

phrases.note_ko: do someone good: (몸 · 마음에) 좋다.
phrases.note_en: do someone good = be good for their health or mood.

phrases.note_ko: Never + 동사원형: ‘절대 ~하지 마’ (명령).
phrases.note_en: Never + base verb = a strong ‘don't’.

phrases.note_ko: have nothing against + 명사 / -ing: 반대할 이유가 없다.
phrases.note_en: have nothing against + noun / -ing = not mind at all.

phrases.en: it will be very hot for you
phrases.note_ko: 사람이 덥다고 할 때는 be hot (I'm hot). It's hot 은 날씨.
phrases.note_en: be hot is about a person (I'm hot); It's hot is about the weather.

phrases.note_ko: under no circumstances: 절대로. 문장 앞에 오면 도치 (should you …).
phrases.note_en: under no circumstances = never; at the start of a clause it inverts the verb (should you …).

phrases.note_ko: the age of + 숫자: ~살.
phrases.note_en: the age of + number = … years old.

phrases.t: fall into the hands of the enemy
phrases.note_ko: fall into the hands of: ~의 손에 넘어가다.
phrases.note_en: fall into the hands of = be caught or taken by.

phrases.note_ko: would rather + 동사원형 (+ than …): 둘 중 차라리 이쪽.
phrases.note_en: would rather + base verb (+ than …) = prefer.

phrases.note_ko: from me: 내 이름으로, 내가 보내는.
phrases.note_en: from me = on my behalf.

phrases.note_ko: write to + 사람: ~에게 편지하다 (미국 영어는 to 를 빼기도 해요).
phrases.note_en: write to someone; in American English ‘to’ is often dropped.

phrases.note_ko: count on + 사람: 믿고 기대다.
phrases.note_en: count on someone = rely on them.

phrases.note_ko: come and + 동사: ~하러 오다 (미국 입말은 come join 도).
phrases.note_en: come and + verb = come to do (informal American: come join).

phrases.en: the man who calls himself king
phrases.note_ko: so-called: 남들이 그렇게 부르지만 인정하지 않는다는 뉘앙스.
phrases.note_en: so-called = what people call it (often with doubt).

phrases.t: I expect you here in April
phrases.en: I'm counting on you coming in April
phrases.note_ko: expect + 사람: 오기를 기다리다, 올 거라 여기다.
phrases.note_en: expect someone = believe they will come.

phrases.t: on the banks of the Seine
phrases.note_ko: the banks of + 강: 강가, 강둑.
phrases.note_en: the banks of a river = its sides.

phrases.note_ko: urge · tell + 사람 + never to …: 절대 ~하지 말라고 당부하다.
phrases.note_en: urge / tell someone never to … = a strong request.
